name: krishibazaar
description: KrishiBazaar (AgriMarket India) — full-stack agri e-commerce app built from the Google Stitch design

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run setup && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
